turns.text: So the problem is the answer is too short.
turns.zh: 所以问题就在于，你的回答太短了。

turns.text: In Part 1, it's true, you do want to give short answers, but not that short.
turns.zh: 在Part 1里，确实，你是应该给简短的回答，但也不能那么短。
别用一个词或者一个短语来回答。

turns.text: I would suggest you develop your answer a little bit, maybe 2 to 3 sentences.
turns.zh: 我建议你把回答稍微展开一点，大概两到三句话。
